text: The Patriots face the Raiders on Sunday depleted at cornerback, with both Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck) ruled out for Week 5, forcing defensive adjustments against Kirk Cousins and an offense that has started the season surprisingly well. The good news arrives on the offensive side, where running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after his injury absence, potentially bolstering the backfield heading into the matchup. Meanwhile, the defensive edge rush has been a bright spot through four games, with Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas exceeding expectations as a trio—a unit that will need to generate pressure given the secondary's personnel challenges. The Patriots will don throwback uniforms for Sunday's game, which will also feature a halftime ceremony honoring Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction, with the celebration to be streamed live on Patriots.com.
